subject: Axis title line breaks with italics

messages.author: c0c155441f2b4723
messages.subject: Axis title line breaks with italics
parts:
Hello! 

I'm trying to insert a line break in the middle of a title on a phylogenetic tree (ggtree) but am having difficulty with using the \n command in conjunction with italics. 

Here is my graph title command: 
Atlantic = expression(paste("Atlantic ", italic("M. senile "), "& ", italic("M. dianthus")))

and I've also tried: 
Atlantic = expression(paste("Atlantic ", italic("M. senile "), "& \n", italic("M. dianthus")))  
in order to break this into two lines, but the attached screenshot is what happens. 

I would like the title to be: 

Atlantic M. senile
& M. dianthus

Thanks in advance! 

Heather

messages.author: e71afdcf4d75bc7a
messages.subject: Re: Axis title line breaks with italics
parts:
Here 's a solution 

I admit this was a bit tricky :P 

  labs(title= bquote(atop('Atlantic'~italic(.("M. senile")),
                          ~italic(.("& M. dianthus")) )) )

M.

messages.subject: Re: Axis title line breaks with italics
parts:
Gorgeous. Thank you for this; it was super helpful! I had to modify it slightly as I hadn't mentioned I was using it with geom_cladelabel and it wasn't thrilled with the use of atop in conjunction with that function. So for anyone searching: 

Atlantic = expression(atop(paste("Atlantic ", italic("M. senile")), paste("& ", italic("M. dianthus"))))

clade <- SVD + geom_cladelabel(node=66, label=Atlantic, align = FALSE, offset=1)
